headlines: SPY reversed: opened 737.46, high 739.89, flushed to 725.66 around 15:50Z, now 729.61 (-0.08%) at 11:06 ET (Stocktwits)
AMD -6.4% at 496 after sliding from 555 high to 470.69 low; Stocktwits posters tie the drop to a Hunterbrook short report (unconfirmed)
UNH -5.3% at 331.3, posters say third straight day of losses on the same news (~21% total, unverified)
Gainers: INSM +17%, PANW +5.6%, BABA +2.8%; WMT -1.3% after earnings
Anthropic (ANT) trending #2 on Stocktwits ahead of its Nasdaq debut
Stocklake delayed pulse (14:09Z snapshot): SPY -0.21%, QQQ +0.03%, IWM -0.68%, GLD -0.87%; VIX 22.61, F&G 28.9 fear; breadth 8.9% oversold vs 3.7% overbought
Calendar (Stocklake, major economies): no US releases listed; Japan CPI 23:30Z; UK and Canada retail sales tomorrow

rumors.text: Hunterbrook published a short report on AMD that triggered the intraday plunge; bulls call it fake news to hit stops
rumors.why: A credible short thesis on a megacap AI chip name could keep pressure on semis and QQQ/SPY

rumors.text: US data today was weak: poor manufacturing index, higher than expected jobless claims, housing index lowest since 2012
rumors.why: If true, growth worries could explain the reversal and extend a 6th straight red day; Stocklake calendar shows no such US releases

rumors.text: Anthropic (ANT) indicated to open at $106 in its Nasdaq debut vs an $83 IPO price
rumors.why: A hot AI IPO could pull money from other AI names or lift AI sentiment broadly

rumors.text: UNH falling for a third day on the same news, down about 21% in total
rumors.why: Continued managed-care selling weighs on the Dow and health care in SPY

plays.reason: Failed +1.3% gap reversed to flat on an AMD/semis flush; failed gaps often close weak, but SPY already bounced 4 points off 725.66 and fear is elevated, so near a coin flip
plays.catalyst: AMD short-report selling and unverified weak-data chatter vs dip buying from oversold breadth

readings.whats_new: The gap failed: SPY went from about 737 last hour (high 739.89) to a 725.66 low and sits near flat at 729.61. The trigger looks like AMD's sudden drop from 555 to 471 (short-report chatter) plus UNH -5%; last hour's thinkorswim outage and put-heavy chatter faded, and Anthropic's IPO is the new trending story.
